title: Sub-10 nm Yb3+/Er3+-doped NaYF4 core–shell upconversion nanoparticles: precise size control and enhanced luminescence
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24905-24916
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02389K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Umme Farva, Young Gwon Jung, Kang Taek Lee
Highly crystalline and luminescent sub-10 nm NaYF4:Yb3+/Er3+@NaYF4 core–shell UCNPs are synthesized using the thermal decomposition method. Optimized conditions yield efficient UC and enhanced crystallinity through rapid α to β phase transition.
